source: Bordeaux Métropole, 'Patrimoine arboré de Bordeaux Métropole' (ec_arbre_p), filtered to the patrimonial/remarkable subset only
licence_proof: Dataset metadata (fetched 2026-08-13) states license: "Licence Ouverte", license_url: https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf.
designation: statut_patrimonial = REMARQUABLE_SYMBOLIQUE (includes combined values with CLASSE_COMME_MONUMENT_OU_SITE_PLU)
scope: IMPORTANT: the source dataset is the metropole's FULL tree inventory (80,025 records), which our own rule forbids importing wholesale. This file holds ONLY the 227 records the register itself tags statut_patrimonial=REMARQUABLE_SYMBOLIQUE, a genuine semantic designation the city applies per tree, not a bulk import. Of the 227, 142 stand in Bordeaux commune itself, 75 in Mérignac, and the rest scattered across Bassens, Bègles, Gradignan, Le Haillan and Ambarès-et-Lagrave (all Bordeaux Métropole communes, so within the metro's own reach). A separate 171 records carry CLASSE_COMME_MONUMENT_OU_SITE_PLU (132 overlapping with REMARQUABLE_SYMBOLIQUE, 39 standalone); the 39 standalone ones were left out of this import as a weaker signal (a planning-document classification rather than a remarkable designation) and are worth a second look.
caveat: status_life ('statut' field, VIVANT/SOUCHE) is the closest thing to a vitality field this register has: 221 of the 227 are VIVANT (alive), 6 are SOUCHE (stump) and must never ship. 'vigueur' (vigour: ELEVEE/MOYENNE/FAIBLE) is null for most of this subset so cannot be relied on. age_approximatif and circonference_tronc are frequently null in this subset (many entries have only species, site and coordinates); treat presence of a number as a lead to verify, not a publishable fact on its own. girth/diameter fields are already in centimetres per the field name and a spot check against known Bordeaux trees, unlike the Portugal register's metres trap, but sanity-check per record before trusting one. CORRECTED ON REVIEW 2026-08-13: status_life is NOT sufficient. Seven entries carry a date_disparition (one as recent as 2024-12-11, Merignac's ginkgo) while status_life still reads VIVANT, so the felling date is the real vitality signal and status_life lags it. Every row now carries `publishable`; only true rows may be considered, and a run must still confirm the tree stands.
